audience: UK freelancers who file self-assessment and keep receipts in a folder
task: A product page that shows a reconciled statement table above the fold; call to action: upload a CSV.
facts: Reads CSV exports from 9 UK banks
Sample statement: 42 lines; 36 matched to receipts automatically, 3 flagged as duplicates, 1 transfer, 2 need a receipt
Matching accuracy on 1,800 test lines: 96.4% (the remaining 3.6% go to a review list)
Exports to the HMRC self-assessment categories
Free for 50 lines a month; £6 a month unlimited
Data stays in the UK (London region); deleted 30 days after account closure
mustInclude: The 42-line sample with the counts that add up
